description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.identity parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: A duplicate SessionEvent builds the canonical dict, then returns CANONICAL_JSON_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits an SL003 finding.
A duplicate mapping returns CANONICAL_JSON_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits a finding. Do not build the provenance dict and do not hash.

Overflow cap_findings keeps the Python prefix and appends an SL003 finding. This card does not pin that fingerprint because cap, total_duplicate_ids, and truncated_count are outside the evidence allowlist.
A float id is PYTHON_FLOAT_STR_UNREPRESENTABLE. Rust Display is not Python str.
A list or mapping id is PYTHON_STR_UNREPRESENTABLE. No Python repr.
A bool is not an int. True becomes the text True only as an id coercion.
EvidenceLookup::Borrowed is a failed borrow, not a missing key.
